cases.name: depth-positive
cases.tradeoff: L2 lifecycle/component calls and the L3 resolved Burst attribute, IJobParallelFor base, and Execute method must occur in the same authored Assets C# class; generated Library and package sources are excluded.

cases.name: one-required-signal-missing
cases.tradeoff: One required high-precision signal is absent; the depth rule must fail closed.

cases.name: lower-rule-required-signal-missing
cases.tradeoff: The independent lower-depth rule remains gated even when the higher structural pattern is present.

cases.name: generated-library-source
cases.tradeoff: Unity Library cache source is generated and excluded before parsing.
